notes.title: v0.915 – Major Update! New Features, Dialogs, Improvements
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619028/a85abcbcf6f3dcfceefceb44ffb80cc85e86a667.gif"]

A major update has arrived for It’s John’s House! Explore new anomalies, finalized voice-over, save points, and a swaying flashlight that heightens tension. Darker, more twisted dialogues and smarter AI make every encounter unpredictable. Updated rooms, hidden view points, and improved visuals bring the house’s horrors to life like never before.



Full Patch Notes – v0.915

🔹 New Features

Voice-over finalized – full narration now fully implemented

Save points – restart from the last room after death, making exploration less punishing

Swaying flashlight – adds more atmosphere (can be disabled in Settings)

View points – new locations where the player can pause and observe the environment

New anomalies – more creepy, mysterious events to discover

🔹 Gameplay & AI Improvements

Dialogues rewritten – darker, creepier, more twisted, and more emotional

Anomaly tooltips – now appear with a short delay; must keep the cursor on them to reveal

Death camera upgraded – more cinematic and unsettling

AI improvements – ghoul can now lurk, follow, and even open cabinets while searching

🔹 Audio & Visuals

Updated soundtrack – enhanced tension and atmosphere

Improved visuals and room designs – more detail, better lighting, and rather story telling environments
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for playing It’s John’s House!


This major update improves the experience for all players, whether you’re exploring the demo or diving into the full game. Your feedback shapes the world of John Revenwood, so keep sharing your thoughts in the Community Hub.

- Patrik M.
